purpose: Reviewable checklist only. Store real consent, radiographs, clinical identifiers and agreements outside GitHub in an access-controlled repository. This JSON is not documentary proof or a regulatory filing.
evidence_reference_policy: Do not put proof documents, images, patient IDs, source DICOM filenames, hashes computed from clinical data, or precise clinic identifiers into public PRs or workflow artifacts. Legal reviewer signs physical/offline reference numbers in protected records; no self-clearance by editing this file.
progression: Only a separate future legal+medical approval workflow, with protected off-GitHub evidence and verified data processing venue, may allow a real dataset. This project CI remains synthetic-only and cannot grant production permission.
